title: The Serengeti in the Green Season
excerpt: The green season in the Serengeti brings lush plains, newborn animals and fewer visitors. Why it is worth considering.
body:
The green season in Tanzania runs roughly from November to May, with the short rains in November and December and the long rains from mid-March to May. Many travellers avoid it, but in the Serengeti it can be a wonderful time.

## What makes it special

- **Green landscapes.** Fresh grass, flowers and dramatic skies.
- **Babies.** The calving season in the south peaks around February.
- **Birds.** Migratory birds from Europe and Asia arrive.
- **Fewer vehicles.** Especially in April and May.
- **Lower lodge rates** in some camps.

## Rain

Rain usually comes in afternoon showers rather than all day, although April and May can be very wet. Some roads become muddy and a few camps close in that period.

## Where to go

From December to March, the southern Serengeti and Ndutu. Central Serengeti is good all year.

## Photography

Clear air after the rain, dramatic clouds and green backgrounds make for beautiful photos.

Read [the green season benefits](/blog/tanzania-green-season-benefits/) or [plan your green season safari](/travel-proposal/).
